title: Green Energy Anomaly Detection
description: Random Forest demand forecasting up to 30 days ahead and an LSTM autoencoder that flags inverter anomalies with static and dynamic thresholds.
subtitle: Energy time-series analytics in two parts: a Random Forest that forecasts daily electricity demand 1 to 30 days ahead (test MAPE 1.1–1.7 %), and a multivariate LSTM autoencoder that reconstructs solar inverter and weather signals and flags global and local anomalies with static and rolling thresholds, served through a Flask API.
contributions: Exploratory analysis of daily demand: distribution tests, rolling volatility, seasonality by quarter and weekday, and trend regression.
Automated lag and rolling-mean feature engineering with 30 forward targets, time-series cross-validation, Random Forest tuning, residual analysis, and multi-horizon forecasting.
Merged inverter logs with weather data, ran correlation-based feature selection, and built the LSTM autoencoder with static and dynamic thresholds for global and local anomalies.
Packaged the trained autoencoder as a Flask service that scores uploaded CSV data and returns anomalies as JSON.
